events.rounds: ABA Fri-Sat (3 and 1 arrow); 3D Sun-Mon (3 arrow and 1 arrow).
events.fee: ABA: Adult $55.00, Jnr/Cub $45.00, Family $125.00. 3D: Adult $60.00, Jnr/Cub $50.00, Family $135.00.
events.notes: Safari 2027, the ABA and 3D National Championships, hosted by Mount Clay Archers, Heywood VIC. ABA: Fri 26 and Sat 27 Mar (3 and 1 arrow each day), presentation Saturday evening. 3D: Sun 28 and Mon 29 Mar (3 arrow and 1 arrow each day), presentation Monday evening. Registration and bow check for all events: Thu 25 Mar 2027. Nominations are completed online and paid at registration. They open very early in January 2027. No entry link is published yet. Entries close Sat 20 Mar 2027. Last date for grading is Sat 20 Mar 2027. Champion of Branches team event for both championships; teams must be registered before muster. Catering by the club. Camping at the range; no dogs. Host coordinates: -38.128654513279066, 141.66318515132738. General inquiries: mountclayarchers@outlook.com. Club newsletters: https://www.bowhunters.org.au/newletters-for-the-national-safari/.
events.start_times: Muster 8:00 am each day, start 8:30 am.
